message: 魔将は課題がお好き？

name: Synn
message: 「Fwaaah...」
Training to become the Demon Lord is tough, too. I was prepared for it, but it's not easy.
Instead of sore muscles, a sore brain? I'm sluggish from overusing my spirit and guts.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Morning, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Mornin'...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's up? Were you fixing up the house or something?」
She peers closely at my face. Ah, Nanaka's eyelashes are so long and pretty.

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-um, is there something on my face?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, ah, no」
I casually look away.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I was fixing up the house」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You really keep at it, even though there aren't any tenants」

name: Synn
message: 「You never know when a tenant might show up!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The world might end before that happens」

name: Synn
message: 「That's harsh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, it'd be a problem if a pretty girl moved in」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, because a rival would--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Awawa, it's nothing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Pretty girl or whatever, I don't care. As long as they move in」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn, saying any woman will do means you're way too starved」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaat! So that's what this is about!」

name: Synn
message: 「What do women have to do with starving?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, well that's... You don't need to know!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Soba. If you move in now, Lord Synn'll be all over you whenever he wants.」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Like I'd ever jump Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Who the hell would move in knowing they're gonna get jumped!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's why I said I won't!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I know that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Actually... maybe it'd be better if he did jump me...」

name: Helena
message: 「Are you all doing well, everyone!」

name: Synn
message: 「What brings you here today?」

name: Helena
message: 「Nanaka-chan. About Soltia's assignment.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did you find something out!?」

name: Misa
message: 「So her scheme has been uncovered!」

name: Helena
message: 「I read it from cover to cover.」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sis! If you read all of something that shady, you'll get brainwashed!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's quite alright. To the Chairwoman, it's just water off a duck's back.」

name: Helena
message: 「Lolotte-chan. Come to the Chairwoman's office later.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!? What on earth did I do to deserve this!?」

name: Misa
message: 「You brought that on yourself.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What the heck was that woman planning to do to me, anyway?」

name: Helena
message: 「Nanaka-chan. Do this assignment. That's a Chairwoman's order.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-Whaaaaaat!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat!? H-Hold on a second!」

name: Helena
message: 「No waiting. This is wonderful.」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sis, did you really get brainwashed!?」

name: Helena
message: 「A collection of problems carefully arranged to pinpoint Nanaka-chan's weaknesses--deduced from her midterm results--and boost her academic ability!」

name: Helena
message: 「Even the problems that seem mean-spirited at first glance aren't just bad questions; they're designed to guide her to the next level once she discovers how to solve them.」

name: Misa
message: 「Impressive as expected...」

name: Helena
message: 「Plus, hints hidden so subtly it's practically an art form.」

name: Helena
message: 「And that's not all. The daily quota is two problems. It's calibrated to a level where you can easily solve them if you focus seriously for an hour.」

name: Helena
message: 「If she keeps up with this quota, by the start of the third term, Nanaka-chan will rank within the top 100 in math.」

name: Helena
message: 「It wouldn't be an exaggeration to call this a model example of how individualized assignments should be created.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Um. I kind of feel like you're showering Ms. Sengenin with praise as a teacher, though.」

name: Helena
message: 「I am.」

name: Helena
message: 「When it comes to teaching people, she's superior.」

name: Synn
message: 「Superior to what?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ah, never mind that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis. I get that it's well-made as an assignment, but surely that's not all there is to it, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right. We're talking about a Demon General who infiltrated the academy. There has to be some kind of trick--」

name: Helena
message: 「There are no tricks or gimmicks. It's purely an assignment. Moreover, one crafted out of genuine consideration for her student.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So it's what you'd call the Empty Fort Strategy.」

name: Misa
message: 「There wasn't any strategy to begin with, was there?」

name: Paqy
message: 「So she really was just a top-notch teacher, huh.」

name: Helena
message: 「And so, Nanaka-chan, you are to do this assignment every day from now on.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Seriously!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Seriously. From now on, submit what you've completed to me every Monday. Chairwoman's orders.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No way...」

name: Misa
message: 「If Nanaka-san doesn't want to do it, I will!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lucky!」

name: Helena
message: 「No way. This is for Nanaka-chan, and it's way too easy for Misa-chan」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Synn! Help me out!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Sure」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes!」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan. You mustn't rob study-hating Nanaka-chan of her chance to improve her grades」

name: Synn
message: 「...Hmm. You've got a point, that might not be good」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka. Good luck」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't let her convince you!」
